"# Script to generate a CalculiX input deck for a cantilever beam frequency analysis
import os

# Beam geometry (mm)
L = 150.0  # length along x
H = 12.0   # height along y
T = 6.0    # thickness along z

# Mesh counts (minimum requirements: 16, 4, 2)
Nx = 16
Ny = 4
Nz = 2

# Derived spacing and node counts
dx = L / (2 * Nx)
dy = H / (2 * Ny)
dz = T / (2 * Nz)

n_nodes_x = 2 * Nx + 1
n_nodes_y = 2 * Ny + 1
n_nodes_z = 2 * Nz + 1

def node_id(i, j, k):
    return i * (n_nodes_y * n_nodes_z) + j * n_nodes_z + k + 1

# Generate nodes and collect node sets
nodes = []
nroot_nodes = []
ntip_nodes = []

for i in range(n_nodes_x):
    x = i * dx
    for j in range(n_nodes_y):
        y = j * dy
        for k in range(n_nodes_z):
            z = k * dz
            nid = node_id(i, j, k)
            nodes.append((nid, x, y, z))
            if i == 0:
                nroot_nodes.append(nid)
            elif i == 2 * Nx:
                ntip_nodes.append(nid)

# Generate elements
elements = []

for ex in range(Nx):
    for ey in range(Ny):
        for ez in range(Nz):
            eid = ex * (Ny * Nz) + ey * Nz + ez + 1
            # Grid indices for this element
            i1 = 2 * ex
            i2 = 2 * ex + 2
            j1 = 2 * ey
            j2 = 2 * ey + 2
            k1 = 2 * ez
            k2 = 2 * ez + 2
            i_mid = 2 * ex + 1
            j_mid = 2 * ey + 1
            k_mid = 2 * ez + 1

            # Node IDs in C3D20 order
            n1 = node_id(i1, j1, k1)
            n2 = node_id(i2, j1, k1)
            n3 = node_id(i2, j2, k1)
            n4 = node_id(i1, j2, k1)
            n5 = node_id(i1, j1, k2)
            n6 = node_id(i2, j1, k2)
            n7 = node_id(i2, j2, k2)
            n8 = node_id(i1, j2, k2)
            n9 = node_id(i_mid, j1, k1)
            n10 = node_id(i2, j_mid, k1)
            n11 = node_id(i_mid, j2, k1)
            n12 = node_id(i1, j_mid, k1)
            n13 = node_id(i_mid, j1, k2)
            n14 = node_id(i2, j_mid, k2)
            n15 = node_id(i_mid, j2, k2)
            n16 = node_id(i1, j_mid, k2)
            n17 = node_id(i1, j1, k_mid)
            n18 = node_id(i2, j1, k_mid)
            n19 = node_id(i2, j2, k_mid)
            n20 = node_id(i1, j2, k_mid)

            conn = [n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n9, n10, n11, n12, n13, n14, n15, n16, n17, n18, n19, n20]
            elements.append((eid, conn))

# Write the input deck
filename = "model.inp"
with open(filename, "w") as f:
    # Heading
    f.write("*HEADING\n")
    f.write("Cantilever beam natural frequencies\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Nodes
    f.write("*NODE\n")
    for nid, x, y, z in nodes:
        f.write(f"{nid}, {x}, {y}, {z}\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Elements
    f.write("*ELEMENT, TYPE=C3D20, ELSET=EALL\n")
    for eid, conn in elements:
        # First line: element ID + first 15 nodes (16 entries total)
        first = [eid] + conn[:15]
        line = ", ".join(map(str, first))
        f.write(line + "\n")
        # Second line: remaining 5 nodes
        second = conn[15:]
        line = ", ".join(map(str, second))
        f.write(line + "\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Node sets
    f.write("*NSET, NSET=NROOT\n")
    for i in range(0, len(nroot_nodes), 16):
        chunk = nroot_nodes[i:i+16]
        line = ", ".join(map(str, chunk))
        f.write(line + "\n")
    f.write("\n")

    f.write("*NSET, NSET=NTIP\n")
    for i in range(0, len(ntip_nodes), 16):
        chunk = ntip_nodes[i:i+16]
        line = ", ".join(map(str, chunk))
        f.write(line + "\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Material
    f.write("*MATERIAL, NAME=STEEL\n")
    f.write("*ELASTIC\n")
    f.write("210000.0, 0.3\n")
    f.write("*DENSITY\n")
    f.write("7.85e-9\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Solid section
    f.write("*SOLID SECTION, ELSET=EALL, MATERIAL=STEEL\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Boundary conditions (clamp root face)
    f.write("*BOUNDARY\n")
    f.write("NROOT, 1, 6, 0.0\n")
    f.write("\n")
